subject: E-Commerce
title: 3D Product Views
description: A micro-lesson that makes 3D Product Views usable.

hook.text: Shopify stores with 3D product views see 94% higher conversion than stores with flat photos. Depth sells.

buildup.text: Static product photos show 4-6 angles. 3D views let shoppers spin, zoom, and examine products from every direction.

discovery.text: Apple uses 3D views for every product on its website. You can rotate the MacBook and examine every port and detail.

twist.text: Creating 3D product models used to cost $500+ per item. AI now generates photorealistic 3D models from a few photos.

climax.text: 3D product views will become standard as creation costs approach zero. Flat photos will feel as dated as printed.

punchline.text: 94% higher conversion. 3D views turn web pages into virtual stores where you.

quiz.question: How much do 3D product views improve conversion rates?
